difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the separation properties of a morphism of algebraic stacks hold if and only if they hold for its base change along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5985-5993, label lemma-check-separated-on-ui-cover). The proof (source lines 5995-6037) reduces to the diagonal through the base change formula, applies the covering criterion for properties of representable morphisms and reads the separation properties back off the diagonal (proof lines 5995-6036). The reduction and the application of the covering criterion are the substance. H3.
